followUpRun.confirmedRootCause: buildOciCreateArgs passed --pid private, which Docker rejects. Docker uses a private PID namespace when the PID mode is omitted.
followUpRun.outcome: The CI annotation confirmed the same root cause in the OCI job and integration job. A local fix removes the unsupported option and checks that Docker inspect reports the default PidMode as an empty string; this fix still requires a successful real-Docker rerun.
